item.skt: saM sin+d+hi ma h Ashri he ru ka no pi ka nA ma
item.coloph: sgrub pa chen po yang dag grub pa zhes bya ba/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po badz+ra hUM ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bod kyi lha btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi bka' lung gi dpal na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po hU~M ka ra de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba ban+de snubs nam mkha'i snying pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
